files.content:
Synthetic property wording. Northfen Wharf Ltd is fictional.
Clause 1.1 The wording covers physical loss of or damage to the buildings at Example Wharf during the period of insurance.
Clause 4.2 The wording excludes loss or damage caused by flood.
Clause 5.1 The insured must take reasonable precautions to prevent loss.
Clause 6.1 It is warranted that the sprinkler system is kept in full working order.
Clause 8.1 Flood means the escape of water from the normal confines of any natural or artificial watercourse.
Clause 2.1 The maximum payable for buildings is GBP 2500000 any one occurrence.
Clause 3.1 The deductible is GBP 5000 each and every loss.
Clause 7.1 Notice of a claim must be given as soon as reasonably practicable.
Clause 9.1 The schedule also refers to goods in transit.
This text is synthetic. It is not a real policy wording.

Old endorsement, outside the window for this exercise.
Clause E1 The endorsement adds cover for flood at the buildings.
